# API

The [API reference](api/spec/index.html) is rendered from `api/openapi.yaml`, the OpenAPI 3.1 document that the
binary serves at `/api/v1/openapi.yaml`, so it describes this version of Muster. In short:

- **Listeners.** The API is served under `/api/v1` on the app listener, next to the UI; ingestion, Heartbeats
  and messenger callbacks under `/api/v1` on the ingest listener; the health checks and `/metrics` on the
  internal listener.
- **Authentication.** The UI uses a session cookie, with the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every request that changes
  something. Scripts send a Personal access token (`mstr_pat_`) or a Service account token (`mstr_sat_`) as a
  bearer token. An Integration token (`mstr_int_`) is accepted only by ingestion and the Heartbeat.
- **Identifiers.** URLs carry the `public_id` of a resource: a type prefix of one or two letters and 12
  characters of Crockford base32, such as `AGK7M3QX9P2RTA`; never the `#N` of an Alert Group.
- **Pagination.** Lists take `cursor` and `limit` (50 by default, at most 500), and a page carries
  `next_cursor`.
- **Errors.** Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `type`, a stable `code`
  where a refusal needs one, and `errors[]` with a JSON pointer per invalid field. An operation that this version
  does not implement yet answers `501`.
- **Concurrency.** A configuration resource carries an `ETag`; an update sends it in `If-Match` and gets `412`
  when it no longer matches, `428` without it.
- **Values.** Times are RFC 3339 in UTC; durations are whole seconds in `*_seconds`, retention periods whole days
  in `*_days` and measured latencies milliseconds in `*_ms`; enums are snake_case. Secrets are write-only: a read
  shows only whether one is set and when it was last changed, in `<field>_status`.
- **Rate limits.** `429` with `Retry-After`, per token; ingestion is not rate-limited.
